_doc: Loot profiles: which item categories a source rolls (relative int weights), how many rolls it makes and its rarity floor (index into rarity.json tiers). 'lab' is the Loot Lab profile (rest menu > Admin Options). Container profiles (Phase 3) add: gear_chance (per-mille, per roll), gold_pct (mean gold per fill as a % of the Common budget at the loot level, paid 50-150% of that), gem_chance (per-mille: the gold is paid as treasure.json gems instead, up to 3, rest in gold), socket_gem_chance (per-mille: one socket gem, loot/gems.json, Phase 5) and consumables ([min, max] picks from consumables.json). Missing keys default to rolls 1, floor 0, gear_chance 1000, no gold, no consumables. creature / boss are the creature-drop profiles (Phase 4); creatures says which class a slain creature is and how often it drops. Profile names are <= 16 chars [a-z0-9_]. scripts: placeable script -> profile; gen-loot-tables.py --apply GENERATES each as a thin wrapper .nss in unpacked/ (mode refill = the 200 s respawning chest, once = the stock open/bash-once behaviour; custom = a hand-written script that is NOT generated but must call its profile by name, e.g. the three Setti coffers with their one-hour cooldown). A profile's optional bases list restricts it to those base-item rows (named-pool awards included). area_overrides: {area resref: {level, reason}} for areas whose chests have no hostile creatures to set a level from (gen-area-loot-levels.py --suggest).

creatures._doc: Creature drops (Phase 4): a PC-credited kill of a creature in a hostile faction (repute.fac reputation toward PCs <= 10, the same rule as the area levels) may leave rolled items on its corpse, on top of its fixed loot. Class: boss = in the Roll of the Fallen registry (brd_db.nss); elite = its CR loot level is at least its area's loot level + elite_margin, or listed in elite_include (and not in elite_exclude); normal otherwise. chance is per mille per kill; profile is the sources profile rolled (its rolls and rarity_floor). The roll is at the creature's own CR loot level (levels.json; boss_overrides pins a boss). Bosses add one roll at CR >= extra_roll_cr and a separate named-pool roll at named_chance per mille. gem_chance (Phase 5) is the per-mille chance of one socket gem (loot/gems.json) on top, at the same loot level; a boss's gem has the gems.json boss_floor. exclude: {resref: reason} never drops (quest creatures). Review the effect with python3 bin/loot-sim.py --creatures (--write regenerates CLAUDE-loot-creature-audit.md).

champions._doc: Diablo-style champions (Phase 4): when a normal creature in a hostile faction spawns (bst_install -> loot_champion.nss), it may become a champion - 'Elite' name prefix, a glow, hp_pct % more hit points, +ab attack, +damage damage (bonus pool), +ac AC and +saves saves - and drops at the elite class's chance. chance is per mille in an area with no natural elites; it falls linearly with the area's natural elite share (per mille of its normal+elite slots), reaching min_chance at density_cap, never below. Its CR is raised by what the toolset formula's hit-point term pays for the extra HP, so kill XP and the drop's loot level follow. Never: bosses, natural elites, summons, plot/immortal, exclude, LOOT_NONE / LOOT_NO_CHAMP.

wishlist._doc: Phase 6 (lo-wishlist). A character picks up to 'picks' base items (rest menu > Loot wishlist...; lootdb loot_wishlist). Each gear roll made FOR that character (the chest opener, or a random damage contributor present at the kill) draws its base item from the wishlist with 'chance' per mille, uniformly among the picks the source profile allows (its categories and its 'bases' filter); otherwise the roll is unchanged. Rarity, affixes and budget never change. With an empty wishlist and Auto on, the candidates are AUTO: tier 1 = the melee/ranged bases whose weapon-focus family feats (baseitems.2da WeaponFocusFeat .. WeaponOfChoiceFeat) the character holds, weight 'focus_weight' per feat held; if none, tier 2 = every melee/ranged/caster base the character is proficient with (holds any ReqFeat0-4, or the base has none), at its bases.json weight, a magic staff only for a character whose spellcasting classes (classes.2da SpellCaster) hold at least half its levels. Auto off + empty wishlist = plain random loot.
